scripts.build:dashboard: cd .. && npm install && cross-env DESKTOP=1 vite build
scripts.prep: npm run build:dashboard && cd ../vault-service && npm install --omit=dev
scripts.package:win: npm run prep && electron-packager . "HomeSafe Vault" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --extra-resource=../vault-service --extra-resource=../dist/client --ignore=^/release && node rename-dashboard.cjs release/"HomeSafe Vault-win32-x64"/resources
scripts.package:mac: npm run prep && electron-packager . "HomeSafe Vault" --platform=darwin --arch=arm64,x64 --out=release --overwrite --extra-resource=../vault-service --extra-resource=../dist/client --ignore=^/release && node rename-dashboard.cjs "release/HomeSafe Vault-darwin-arm64/HomeSafe Vault.app/Contents/Resources" && node rename-dashboard.cjs "release/HomeSafe Vault-darwin-x64/HomeSafe Vault.app/Contents/Resources"
scripts.package:linux-arm64: npm run prep && electron-packager . "HomeSafe Vault" --platform=linux --arch=arm64 --out=release --overwrite --extra-resource=../vault-service --extra-resource=../dist/client --ignore=^/release && node rename-dashboard.cjs release/"HomeSafe Vault-linux-arm64"/resources
